title: Nyama Choma: Grilled Meat, Tanzanian Style
excerpt: Nyama choma, grilled meat, is a social meal in Tanzania. What it is, where to eat it and what comes with it.
body:
## What is it?

Nyama choma means "grilled meat" in Swahili. Usually goat or beef, sometimes chicken, grilled slowly over charcoal.

## How it is served

Often with kachumbari (tomato and onion salad), salt, chilli and ugali or grilled bananas.

## Social

Eating nyama choma is often a social event with friends and family, especially at weekends.

## Where

Local bars and restaurants in Arusha, Moshi and Dar es Salaam. Ask your guide.

## Vegetarian?

Grilled maize and bananas are tasty alternatives.
